shifts.name: 4-2 area-3 drift
shifts.evidence: Every structure above the floor row 13 from the hanging brick mass (free tiles x 701-789, native Mario passes x 762-777 at feet 91-104) to the side pipe at x 3008 and its vertical pipe lies 16 px to the right of where native rows put it: seven native piranha plants (id 13, object x = pipe left + 8: 1160 1256 1352 1720 2216 2280 2888) sit 16 px left of the remake's pipes (1168 1264 1360 1728 2224 2288 2896, plant specs 1270 1368 1736 2296 2904), the native Buzzy Beetle turns at x 1279 (pipe right edge 1280, remake 1296), native Mario lands on the first pipe at x 1267 and loses support at x 1280, and the walk-offs at x 912, 1279 and 2306 happen 16/17/14 px before the remake's ledge edges. The brick mass from x 3072 touches the roof-route witnesses of data/vine-optional-farend-running.json (cols 199+) and stays. Rows at floor level (13-14) have no native evidence and stay.

shifts.name: 1-2 area-2 drift
shifts.evidence: Everything above floor row 13 from x 1344 to 2575 lies 16 px right of native: native plants (id 13, object x = pipe left + 8) at 1656 and 1752 against remake pipes 1664 and 1760 (plant specs 1672/1768); native Mario lands on the second pipe top (feet 144) at x 1743 (support needs pipe x <= 1756, the remake pipe 1760 gave no support, 2 rows); native Mario lands on the brick ledge (feet 160) at x 1947 and walks off its right end at x 1987 (last supported x 1982-1984: edge 1984, remake 2000), and rows 1992-1997 (feet 164-169) pass through the remake cell (1984,160); the bricks at 2214-2219 (feet 146-150) and the right end of the 2336-2431 block (native walks off it at x 2422, edge 2416 = 2432 - 16; rows 2422-2429 feet 130-136 cross it) clear with the same shift (GEODRIFT=1 64 px windows 1728-1791, 1920-2047, 2176-2239, 2368-2431: violations s=0 2/3/2/3 -> s=+16 0/0/1/1). Seven anchors, none against. The left bound is the weakest part: structures at x <= 1263 do NOT move (a goomba falls off the brick row 1216-1263 at the same x natively and in the remake, landings/ledges at 804-1262 prefer s = 0) and native only jumps over the 1280-1327 pit (landing x 1342, consistent with both), so the boundary was put just after the pit; the only structure that depends on it is a 6x2 brick block at 1344-1423 (y 112-143) that native Mario passes under at feet 208. Rows at floor level (13-14: the pits at 1936-1967, 2000-2031, 2224-2319, 2464-2575) have no native evidence and stay. The right bound is the start of the warp-zone roof extension (cols 161+, x 2576), which is the separate entry '1-2 area-2 end block drift' below. Left bound moved 1344 -> 1440 (2026-11-11, native collision map RAM 0x500-0x69f of the full route, tools/harness/map-audit.mjs): the native map holds that 6x2 brick block and its coin row at cols 84-89 (rows 5, 7, 8; 83-84 route rows each), i.e. unshifted; the shifted copy at 83-88 disagreed in cols 83 and 89.

shifts.name: 1-2 area-2 end block drift
shifts.evidence: The end block (brick mass, side exit pipe and its vertical pipe, roof, the three warp pipes, right wall; cols 161-192) was registered against the same drifted exit pipe as the rest of 1-2 area-2 (data/observed-levels.json area-2 cols 161-174 and data/warp-1-2-observations.json, anchor pipe 2672, camera 2473) and lies 16 px right of native. Native rows: the side-pipe walk ends with Mario stopped at x 2656 for 30 rows (rows 3823-3852, engine 2) where the map's pipe mouth stood at 2672; the same walk ends at the pipe's left edge in 2-2 (3024), 4-2 (2992, shifted likewise), 7-2 (3024) and 8-4 (1088), each at trigger + 13 (1-2 trigger 2643 + 13 = 2656); the native plant (id 13, slot 3, rows 3790-3801) of the first warp pipe is at x 2856 = pipe left 2848 + 8 where the map had pipe 2864 and plant 2872. The camera values of the roof observations were derived from the same pipe anchor (camera = anchor world x - anchor screen x 199), so the camera stop, the warp activation camera, the area width and the sign/number positions follow by -16 with the screen positions unchanged (data/warp-1-2-runtime.json is already in the native frame, so no piranhas flag here: the plant specs it creates are final). Rows 13-14 (the continuous floor of the extension) stay as in the entry above; the leftmost brick column (x 2560) therefore stands over the pit tile column of rows 13-14 (not reachable). The observation tiles of data/warp-1-2-observations.json stay in the screenshot frame; tests/roof-warp.test.ts maps them through this shift.

edits.name: 1-2 area-2 native floor/stair cells
edits.evidence: Native collision map (full route trace, tools/harness/map-audit.mjs --dump): col 160 rows 13-14 is floor natively (124 route rows; native pit 153-159) but is left empty (the column the floor drift vacates): tests/roof-warp.test.ts maps the screenshot-frame blank cells 155-160 of rows 13-14 unshifted, and no native row stands there; the pit under the staircase is 7 columns wide natively (138-144, map 139-144: its left edge moves with the drift, its right edge does not), so col 144 is removed after the shift; the staircase at 2112 is 5 columns wide natively (rows 12/11/10/9 from cols 133/134/135/136 to col 137, value 0x61) and col 138 is empty in rows 9-12 (84 route rows); native small Mario stands with a foot over col 138 only while the other is on col 137 (7 rows). The stair's left side (entry '1-2 area-2 staircase at 2112') is unchanged.

edits.name: 4-2 area-3 brick at col 87 row 8
edits.evidence: Native collision map: col 87 row 8 holds 0x52 in all 88 route rows that saw it (map empty). Free play: native small Mario stands at feet 128 over it (explore-r2 4-2 mood0 rows 691-715, explore-r4 4-2 mood6 rows 722-743, 89 rows in r2-r4) and is stopped at x 1379 rising at y 104 (r4 mood6 row 709, speed 10296 -> 28); the remake fell through.

edits.name: 6-1 main floor row 13 cells
edits.evidence: Native collision map (full route trace, tools/harness/map-audit.mjs --dump): the top floor row 13 of the map is one column right of native from col 164 to 176 (native floor 167-173 and from 176, pits 164-166 and 174-175; map 168-174 and from 177) while row 14 already matches except col 176; native small Mario stands on col 167 (6 rows), which the map lacks in row 13. Not applied: cols 134-135 of row 13 are floor natively (87-88 rows, Mario stands on 135 for 2 rows) but tests/native-geometry-corrections.test.ts asserts no support at x 2150 (open). Col 136 stays solid although the native map holds 0 there: native Mario runs over it at feet 208 (rows 47668-47686, edge straddle, see entry '6-1 main floor from x 2176' and its test), which the remake's support needs a tile for.
